name: OmaLumineCapture
author: Bram van Oploo
description: LumineCapture integration for Omarchy: bar launcher with automatic AUR dependency installation, conflict-checked global keybinding, and a full configuration panel for LumineCapture

barWidget.description: LumineCapture launcher with AUR auto-install, keybinding and configuration

schema.label: Capture keybinding
schema.description: Global shortcut chord to start a LumineCapture session. Empty disables the binding.

schema.label: Launch arguments
schema.description: Arguments passed to lumine-capture (e.g. '-r -t sc'). Empty opens the editor.
